title: Surreal Mystic Voyage
description: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene depicts two red-sailed Viking-style ships navigating glowing yellow spiral patterns on a green sea. In the foreground a woman in blue kneels on a stone dock beside a glowing blue chest, while a sorcerer in a pink robe casts spells near a demonic castle with flaming towers under a swirling cosmic sky filled with suns, moons, scrolls, and magical symbols.
prompt: Highly detailed surreal fantasy painting of two red-sailed longships with spiral symbols sailing through glowing yellow concentric circles on a swirling green sea. A woman in blue kneels on a stone pier beside an ornate glowing blue chest, pink butterflies around her. In the background a dark castle with flaming towers and demonic faces, a purple-robed wizard casting blue magic, another figure in red. Cosmic swirling sky with multiple suns, green moon, floating scrolls, owls, black lotus symbol, and magical particles. Vibrant colors, intricate details, fantasy illustration style.
